title: Zelda Stable
description: This mod fully ports the classic stables from The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild into Minecraft.
body:
This mod fully ports the classic stables from **The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild** into Minecraft. It naturally generates stable buildings with the iconic horse-head roof in the Overworld, providing players with safe and reliable supplies and rest stops during their adventures, and recreating the travel experience of the Hyrule continent.
Features
Naturally generates Breath of the Wild-style stables, spawning across various biomes including plains and forests
Provides safe resting areas that serve as temporary shelters to hide from monsters
Adds new stable NPCs for trading to obtain adventure supplies
Lightweight design, compatible with vanilla survival mode and multiplayer servers

Inspired and architectural style derived from:Grazzy（youtuber）
